replies.author: @brita_lisa

replies.text: Compressed vol regimes almost never last; historically you get a sharp expansion once everyone is positioned the same way.
replies.author: decoy

replies.text: the honest answer is that low volatility usually precedes a significant move up or down. market sentiment hasn't changed, but the lack of price discovery might indicate a shift in investor behavior.
replies.author: @adelbucetta

replies.text: Low volatility usually does not last forever. The question is not whether BTC moves, but which direction gets confirmed.
replies.author: @TokenTrailHQ

decoy_rationale: Sounds like a textbook risk note — “historically” plus neat regime language without the messy shorthand of real traders.
